long_biography.plain_text:
At Vignobles Aubert, Héloïse Aubert-Sénéchal combined responsibility for making wine with selling it to customers in France, northern Europe and Asia. She served as cellar master for estates in the Saint-Émilion satellite appellations, working alongside her cousins Vanessa and Yohann. Each cousin had production responsibilities as well as particular markets to develop.

Her preparation included viticulture and oenology studies, a business degree and a master's in agriculture, with practical experience at Morgenster in South Africa. She regarded production and sales as mutually useful disciplines. Knowing how the wines were made strengthened her sales conversations, while direct contact with buyers helped her understand what consumers expected.
